quotations.old_english: God gesceapo ferede ǽghwylcum on eorþan eormencynnes
quotations.english: God has borne his decrees to every one of the human race on earth

source_text: eormen-cyn, -cynn, es; n. The human race; h&u-long;m&a-long;num g&e-short;nus :-- God gesceapo ferede ǽghwylcum on eorþan eormencynnes God has borne his decrees to every one of the human race on earth, Exon. 88 b; Th. 333, 3; Vy. 96 : Beo. Th. 3918; B. 1957.
